name: LS Networks Corporation Limited
summary: LS Networks Corporation Limited is a diversified enterprise with operations spanning consumer brands and retail, global trading, and asset management. The company is known for its PROSPECS brand, under which it produces and markets walking-related products. Its extensive trading activities encompass a wide array of goods, including raw materials, industrial equipment, machinery and plant components, telecommunications and power solutions, and new and renewable energy technologies. Additionally, it trades in steel products—from raw materials and semi-finished goods to finished items—as well as various non-ferrous metals. The company further engages in real estate management, offering rental services. Established in 1949 and headquartered in Gimhae-si, South Korea, LS Networks conducts business internationally, maintaining a strong presence in regions such as South Korea, Russia, Central Asia, Eastern Europe, and North Africa. It operates as a subsidiary of E1 Corporation.
